description: On the red bedspread in front of you are a small white cabinet-like piece with a knob and a separate white drawer tray beside it. The left hand steadies the cabinet while the right hand grips the drawer tray, lifts it up and over, aligns it with the cabinet opening, then slides it inward until it sits flush; the right hand briefly presses at the front and then releases while the left hand keeps the cabinet in place.
